sources.note: The current JFK-SDF page has no published nonstop service and lists Delta as ended in May 2026.
The current JFK-IAH direct-route page lists JetBlue Airways rather than DL; the DL carrier attribution is unresolved and must not be treated as operating-carrier evidence.
Current JTR→MAD nonstop service is Iberia, not Air Europa.
Return passenger services include Seattle, Dallas-Fort Worth, Los Angeles, New York and San Francisco. This catalog does not copy the article's weekly frequencies.
The North America service announcement identifies Cathay's New York gateway as JFK; no EWR edge is inferred.
Direct British Airways service to New York is described. The separate schedule announcement disambiguates LHR/JFK; do not create every London/New York airport combination.
Historical announcement explicitly distinguishes JFK/Heathrow service and the reverse daylight flight. Current destination page corroborates route service; historical frequency is not reused.
Names American-operated routes between JFK/LAX, JFK/SFO and BOS/LAX. Equipment-introduction dates are not route start dates and are not stored as service validity.

JAL Group route publication distinguishes code-sharing airports with (c) and states that only JAL Group nonstop flights are shown on the map. It identifies New York as JF Kennedy; map presence alone does not establish a current origin pair.

JAL official Summer-2026 North America timetable. Exact route + flight-number evidence; New York airport identity is cross-checked against the JAL Group route publication rather than inferred from the city name.
Qatar Airways explicitly states it operates New York City (JFK) to Doha. Separate directional evidence.

Qantas' current international flight network lists active bidirectional 'Between' routes and explicitly labels one-stop services with 'via'. Only pairs listed without 'via' are used as nonstop route evidence; no codeshare, QantasLink or domestic denominator is inferred.
Turkish Airlines separately describes direct New York to Istanbul service. Used as separate directional evidence for JFK-IST.

Air New Zealand's Auckland page publishes exact-code nonstop inbound routes from WLG, CHC, ZQN, DUD and IVC and also identifies current inbound international nonstop service. These directions are used independently rather than inferred from outbound services.

Air New Zealand publishes NZ1 JFK-AKL and NZ2 AKL-JFK as Air New Zealand-operated nonstop services. Used here as exact directional route/operator evidence; the legacy weekly pattern is not promoted into GCMP's dated schedule catalog.

Air India official international connectivity map says it flies nonstop to 41 destinations and draws bidirectional arrows between each listed overseas airport and the named Indian airport(s). It is a broad route-universe snapshot, not a current dated timetable; later current advisories and route launches override it where applicable.

Current Air India homepage advisory states all Air India flights to all Middle East destinations are suspended. Middle East pairs shown on the February route map are therefore not inserted as current positive route evidence in this round.

SWISS' current New York flightplan resolves exact JFK and EWR airports. Unmarked LX14/15/16/17 operate ZRH-JFK/JFK-ZRH and LX18/19 operate ZRH-EWR/EWR-ZRH, while LX3218/3219 are explicitly labeled operated by UA and are excluded.

SWISS' current Geneva-New York flightplan lists LX22 GVA-JFK and LX23 JFK-GVA without a partner-operator label while separately marking EWR marketing rows LX3216/3217 as operated by UA. Only the JFK pair is retained for LX.

Austrian's current nonstop New York flightplan separately identifies OS35 VIE-JFK / OS36 JFK-VIE and OS37 VIE-EWR / OS38 EWR-VIE. GCMP retains only those exact airport pairs and never creates a generic NYC route.

Royal Jordanian's Quick Reference Timetable No.473 is explicitly valid 01Sep-30Sep 2026 and publishes exact airport codes, directional flight identities and special From/To AQJ/ADJ rows. Its legend marks one-stop services with * and RO/GF/WY-operated codeshare aircraft with #; the reviewed September flight rows contain no # marker and YYZ is the only * one-stop city row. GCMP retains only exact direct legs that can be represented without decomposing the YYZ through service.
Current Brussels Airlines flightplan lists SN501 BRU-JFK and SN502 JFK-BRU, while separately marking EWR marketing rows as operated by UA. Only the SN-operated JFK pair is retained.
Current ITA Airways flightplan lists AZ-operated FCO-JFK services and the return direction. The page labels the connection non-stop; partner-operated rows are not used.

Asiana's operational-routes notice lists current 2026 ICN-JFK/LAX/SFO/SEA services with exact OZ flight identities. GCMP retains selected directional route evidence only; detailed date exceptions remain outside this route-first tranche.

South African Airways' current corporate history says SAA flies between Johannesburg and Accra; the current fare page independently shows September 2026 JNB-ACC inventory. Used as route-only evidence.
Current SAA fare page shows exact JNB-ACC September 2026 inventory. Combined with the airline network statement above; no reverse direction is inferred from fares alone.

ODbL ADSBiq aircraft-diff observations from 2026-08-01 through 2026-09-06, using the public 2026-08 and 2026-09 release assets. Only exact active-alliance callsigns observed during this recent window are considered; observation alone does not provide an airport pair. Missing upstream daily assets: 2026-08-30.
CC0 standing-data exact callsign-to-route mapping. A route is retained only when the exact callsign was actually observed in the Aug 1-Sep 6 ADSBiq window.
Public search-index sitemap additionally confirms each retained physical pair remains in the current scheduled-passenger route index (65,052 directional pairs).

2026-Q2 worldwide ADS-B-derived passenger-flight observations. GCMP retains only callsign-validated directional routes with at least two known non-cargo passenger-config observations; this is recent-operation evidence, not a September timetable.

CC0 Virtual Radar Server standing-data callsign-to-route mapping at the pinned commit. Used only to corroborate the observed carrier/route identity; standing-data alone is not treated as an active timetable.

Public search-index route sitemap confirmed that each retained physical airport pair remained present in the current scheduled-passenger route index (65,052 indexed directional pairs). It does not establish the operating carrier by itself.
